description: Static motion audit against WCAG 2.2 (2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide; 2.3.1 Three Flashes; 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions). Pass `html` and/or `css`, or a public `url` (the page and up to 4 same-site stylesheets are fetched). Flags autoplay video and audio, marquee and blink, infinite animations with no pause control, animation patterns that could flash (it cannot measure flash rate), parallax and scroll-linked motion, large translate or scale transitions, smooth scrolling, and durations over 400ms. Reports whether prefers-reduced-motion is honored (counts animations and transitions against reduced-motion rules) and returns a ready-to-paste reduced-motion CSS block. Each finding names its criterion, severity and fix. Reads source only; does not render the page or run script.

css.description: CSS text to analyze, with or without html.

html.description: Page HTML source. Optional if url is given.

url.description: A public page to fetch instead. Up to 4 same-site stylesheets are fetched too.

name: check_motion
title: Motion check
